description: University-provided and recommended protected Microsoft Copilot for study support outside assessments.
howToObtain: Sign in to University Office 365 with the University login, select Copilot, and confirm the protected shield icon.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: For study support outside assessments, the University of Nottingham provides access to and recommends Microsoft Copilot with a University login. It gives the Office 365 sign-in path and says logged-in Copilot does not record prompts, inputs or uploads as training data.
